name: Uttaree
tagline: A collective enterprise of separate ventures.
summary: Uttaree is a collectively owned enterprise. Founding members and shareholders own the group. Each venture is run by a yearly project committee.

seo.title: Uttaree
seo.description: Uttaree is a Rangpur-based enterprise with ventures in electronics, agriculture, and art education.

ownership.statement: Uttaree is not a single-owner firm. It was established in 2024 by its founding members, with shareholders in the ownership. The public site shows those counts only. Personal contact details of members and shareholders are not published.

committeeNote: Each venture has its own committee, selected for one year. The committee is a project director and an assistant director. When the year changes, the new names are added here and the previous year stays on record.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To run Uttaree as a shared enterprise. Founding members and shareholders own the group together. Electronics, agriculture, and the art school each do their own work, in their own place, under a project director and an assistant director chosen for that year. People reach the work through the Uttaree office, not through personal numbers.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: A Rangpur enterprise that stays collectively owned, with each venture understandable on its own: what it does, where it works, and who is responsible for the year. The public record shows ownership as counts, keeps every committee year, and uses one office for contact.

story: Uttaree started in 2024 in Rangpur as a shared enterprise. The people who formed it keep ownership together, and the work is organised as separate ventures rather than one shop under one name.

The ventures cover electronics, agriculture, and art education. A visitor can read what each one does, where it works, and how to reach the Uttaree office. Day-to-day contact is through that office, not through personal numbers.
